source.text: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐταράχθη τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.

records.literal_gloss: These things having said, the Jesus was troubled in the spirit and testified and said, "Truly truly I say to you that one of you will hand over me."

en.L: Having said these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, "Truly, truly I say to you, one of you will hand {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} over."
en.B: After saying this, Jesus was troubled in spirit, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} solemnly declared, "Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you is going to betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: After Jesus said this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was deeply troubled in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} spirit. He told them plainly, "I tell you the truth: one of you will betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Habiendo dicho estas cosas, Jesús se turbó en espíritu, y dio testimonio y dijo: «En verdad, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} me entregará».
es.B: Después de decir esto, Jesús se turbó en su espíritu y declaró solemnemente: «En verdad, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} me va a traicionar».
es.R: Después de decir esto, Jesús se sintió profundamente turbado en su espíritu. Les dijo claramente: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} me va a traicionar».

sw.L: Akiisha kusema haya, Yesu alifadhaika rohoni, akashuhudia na kusema, "Kweli kweli nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanitoa."
sw.B: Baada ya kusema hivyo, Yesu alifadhaika rohoni, naye akatamka waziwazi, "Kweli kweli nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti."
sw.R: Yesu aliposema hayo, alifadhaika sana rohoni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. Akawaambia waziwazi, "Nawaambia ukweli: mmoja wenu atanisaliti."

vi.L: Nói những điều ấy xong, Đức Giê-xu bối rối trong tâm linh, và làm chứng và phán: "Thật vậy, thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, một người trong các con sẽ nộp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Nói xong điều ấy, Đức Giê-xu xao xuyến trong tâm linh, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} long trọng tuyên bố: "Thật vậy, thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, một người trong các con sẽ phản bội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Nói xong điều ấy, Đức Giê-xu vô cùng xao xuyến trong lòng. Ngài nói thẳng với các môn đồ: "Ta nói thật với các con: một người trong các con sẽ phản bội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 이것들을 말씀하시고 나서 예수께서는 영으로 괴로워하셨고, 증언하여 말씀하셨다. "진실로 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희 가운데 하나가 나를 넘겨줄 것이다."
ko.B: 이 말씀을 하신 뒤 예수께서는 속으로 몹시 괴로워하시며 엄숙하게 밝히셨다. "진실로 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희 가운데 한 사람이 나를 배반할 것이다."
ko.R: 이 말씀을 하신 뒤 예수께서는 마음이 몹시 괴로우셨다. 그리고 제자들에게 분명하게 말씀하셨다. "내가 분명히 말한다. 너희 가운데 한 사람이 나를 배반할 것이다."

decisions.choice: troubled in spirit: shaken within his own human spirit
decisions.reason: "Spirit" here is Jesus's own inner self, as in 11:33, where the same words describe him at the tomb of Lazarus. The verb is used of Jesus facing his death (12:27) and of the disciples' hearts (14:1, 27). Here he is shaken by what one of his own friends is about to do.

decisions.choice: testified: a solemn, open declaration
decisions.reason: John uses this verb for bearing witness to the truth (1:7, 34; 3:11; 5:31-39). Joined to "said", it marks what follows as a formal statement made in front of them all: Jesus is not guessing, and he is not taken by surprise (13:18-19).

decisions.choice: one of you will hand me over: one of the Twelve will betray him
decisions.reason: As in 6:64, 6:71 and 12:4, the verb means to hand someone over, and used of Judas it means betrayal. "One of you" puts the betrayer inside the circle at the table, as Psalm 41:10, just quoted (13:18), had said: the one who eats his bread.

decisions.choice: Truly, truly I say to you (L); Truly, truly, I tell you (B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering for John (see 1:51), recorded once in this passage.

decisions.choice: testified and said (L); solemnly declared (B); told them plainly (R); hand over (L); betray (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say in one verb what "testified and said" means (meaning decision m2). As in 6:64, 6:71 and 12:4, Literal keeps the plain sense of "hand over", and Balanced and Readable say what Judas's handing over was (m3). Balanced uses "is going to" for the future, which here means what is about to happen.

decisions.choice: En verdad, en verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering.

decisions.choice: dio testimonio y dijo (L); declaró solemnemente (B); les dijo claramente (R); entregará (L); traicionar (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English (meaning decisions m2, m3).

decisions.choice: alifadhaika rohoni; akashuhudia (L), akatamka waziwazi (B), akawaambia waziwazi (R)
decisions.reason: "Kufadhaika" (to be troubled, shaken), as at 11:33 and 12:27. "Kushuhudia" keeps the Literal "testified"; Balanced and Readable give its sense, a solemn, open declaration.

decisions.choice: Thật vậy, thật vậy, Ta nói với các con (L, B); Ta nói thật với các con (R)
alternatives: Thật, Ta nói thật với các con
decisions.reason: The book-wide Vietnamese form of "Truly, truly" (amen amen), recorded once for this passage (also 13:38).

decisions.choice: Jesus says "Ta" of himself and "các con" to the disciples; the narrator calls him "Ngài"; the verb for his speaking is "phán" at Literal
decisions.reason: Vietnamese pronouns state a relationship. As the style guide sets for the whole book, Jesus speaks to his disciples as a teacher and father to his own ("Ta", "các con"). "Ta" in mid-sentence and the narrator's "Ngài" carry the deity_pronoun setting, which only changes the capital. "Phán", the respectful verb of speaking, is kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable use plainer verbs ("tuyên bố", "nói", "đáp").

decisions.choice: "진실로 진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide Korean rendering of amen amen (style guide, section 6), recorded once for this passage. The archaic ending -노니 is avoided.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean; narrative uses "께서" and the honorific -시- for Jesus, and Jesus speaks to the disciples in the plain style (해라체)
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans as in English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (style guide, section 7); respect for Jesus is carried by the honorific forms. Recorded once for this passage.

decisions.choice: "영으로 괴로워하셨고" (L); "속으로 몹시 괴로워하시며" (B); "마음이 몹시 괴로우셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision places the trouble in Jesus's own human spirit. Literal keeps the word "영"; Balanced and Readable say it as inner distress in everyday words, and the familiar older phrase is avoided.

source.text: ἔβλεπον εἰς ἀλλήλους οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπορούμενοι περὶ τίνος λέγει.

records.literal_gloss: Were looking at one another the disciples, being at a loss about whom he speaks.

en.L: The disciples were looking at one another, at a loss about whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was speaking.
en.B: The disciples looked at one another, puzzled, unable to tell which of them {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} meant.
en.R: The disciples looked at each other. They had no idea which one of them {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was talking about.

es.L: Los discípulos se miraban unos a otros, sin saber de quién hablaba.
es.B: Los discípulos se miraron unos a otros, desconcertados, sin saber a cuál de ellos se refería.
es.R: Los discípulos se miraron unos a otros. No tenían ni idea de a cuál de ellos se refería.

sw.L: Wanafunzi walikuwa wakitazamana, wakishangaa ni juu ya nani anasema.
sw.B: Wanafunzi walitazamana wakiwa wamechanganyikiwa, wasiweze kujua alimaanisha nani kati yao.
sw.R: Wanafunzi walitazamana. Hawakujua kabisa ni yupi kati yao aliyekuwa akimzungumzia.

vi.L: Các môn đồ cứ nhìn nhau, bối rối không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói về ai.
vi.B: Các môn đồ nhìn nhau, bối rối, không biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn nói người nào trong số họ.
vi.R: Các môn đồ nhìn nhau. Họ không hiểu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang nói về người nào trong số họ.

ko.L: 제자들은 그분이 누구에 대하여 말씀하시는지 몰라 당황하며 서로 쳐다보고 있었다.
ko.B: 제자들은 그분이 누구를 두고 하시는 말씀인지 몰라 어리둥절하여 서로 쳐다보았다.
ko.R: 제자들은 서로 얼굴을 쳐다보았다. 예수께서 누구를 두고 하시는 말씀인지 전혀 알 수 없었다.

decisions.choice: at a loss: puzzled, not knowing what to make of it
decisions.reason: The verb describes being at a loss or perplexed, as the women were at the empty tomb (Luke 24:4) and Paul was about the Galatians (Galatians 4:20). The disciples do not suspect anyone in particular; each of the other Gospels says they asked, one after another, whether it was they (Mark 14:19; Matthew 26:22).

decisions.choice: were looking: the imperfect pictures them glancing from one to another
decisions.reason: The tense shows an action going on, as they looked around the table at each other. The next verses take place while they are still wondering.

decisions.choice: he speaks: the present tense of the question as they asked it
decisions.reason: Greek keeps the tense of the question in their minds ("about whom is he speaking?"). It is not a separate historic present, and it is told in the past along with the rest of the sentence.

decisions.choice: which of them (B); which one of them (R)
decisions.reason: "Whom" means one of the people at the table, since Jesus had said "one of you" (verse 21). Balanced and Readable make that plain.

decisions.choice: a cuál de ellos
decisions.reason: As in English.

decisions.choice: cứ nhìn nhau
decisions.reason: The imperfect pictures the disciples glancing from one to another; "cứ" gives that ongoing sense without a tense word.

source.text: ἦν ἀνακείμενος εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς·

records.literal_gloss: Was reclining one of the disciples of him in the bosom of the Jesus, whom was loving the Jesus;

en.L: One of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples was reclining in the bosom of Jesus, [the one] whom Jesus loved.
en.B: One of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining close beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: One of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples was lying right next to Jesus at the table, close to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chest. He was the disciple whom Jesus loved.

es.L: Uno de sus discípulos, al que Jesús amaba, estaba recostado en el seno de Jesús.
es.B: Uno de sus discípulos, el discípulo a quien Jesús amaba, estaba recostado junto a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Uno de sus discípulos estaba recostado justo al lado de Jesús a la mesa, cerca de su pecho. Era el discípulo a quien Jesús amaba.

sw.L: Mmoja wa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alikuwa ameegemea kifuani mwa Yesu, [yule] ambaye Yesu alimpenda.
sw.B: Mmoja wa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, yule mwanafunzi ambaye Yesu alimpenda, alikuwa ameegemea karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kabisa.
sw.R: Mmoja wa wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alikuwa amelala karibu kabisa na Yesu mezani, karibu na kifua {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}. Yeye ndiye yule mwanafunzi ambaye Yesu alimpenda.

vi.L: Một trong các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang nằm nghiêng nơi lòng Đức Giê-xu, [là người] mà Đức Giê-xu yêu thương.
vi.B: Một trong các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, người môn đồ mà Đức Giê-xu yêu thương, đang nằm nghiêng sát bên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Một trong các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang nằm ngay cạnh Đức Giê-xu trong bữa ăn, sát bên ngực {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đó là người môn đồ mà Đức Giê-xu yêu thương.

ko.L: 그분의 제자들 가운데 하나가 예수의 품에 기대어 누워 있었는데, [그는] 예수께서 사랑하시던 [제자였다].
ko.B: 그분의 제자들 가운데 한 사람, 곧 예수께서 사랑하시던 제자가 예수 바로 곁에 기대어 누워 있었다.
ko.R: 제자들 가운데 한 사람이 식탁에서 예수 바로 옆에 누워 예수의 가슴 가까이에 있었다. 그는 예수께서 사랑하시던 제자였다.

decisions.choice: reclining in the bosom: lying next to Jesus at the meal, with his head near Jesus's chest
alternatives: sitting on a chair beside him
decisions.reason: At a formal meal, and at Passover above all, guests lay on couches or cushions around a low table, leaning on the left elbow and eating with the right hand. The one who lay to someone's right had his head close to that person's chest, so he was said to be "in his bosom". It was a place of closeness at the table, and of honor. Verse 25 shows the position: he only has to lean back to speak to Jesus privately.

decisions.choice: whom Jesus loved: a disciple John does not name
decisions.reason: This is the first time the Gospel speaks of a disciple in this way; he appears again at the cross (19:26), at the empty tomb (20:2), and by the lake (21:7, 20). The Gospel never gives his name. The closing verses say that he is the disciple who bears witness to these things and wrote them (21:20-24). Christian tradition from the second century identifies him as John the son of Zebedee, whom this Gospel never names either; others have suggested Lazarus, whom Jesus is also said to love (11:3, 5). The text itself leaves him unnamed. Jesus's love for him does not mean he loved the others less (13:1, 34).

decisions.choice: in the bosom of Jesus: possibly an echo of the Son in the bosom of the Father
alternatives: a plain description of where he lay, with no further meaning
decisions.reason: The same expression describes the Son "in the bosom of the Father" in 1:18, the one who has made the Father known. Here the disciple is in the bosom of Jesus, and he will become the witness who makes Jesus known (21:24). John may intend the parallel; the words also have their everyday meaning at a meal (m1), so the echo cannot be proved.

decisions.choice: in the bosom of Jesus (L); close beside him (B); right next to Jesus ... close to his chest (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as 1:18, so the same English: Literal "in the bosom", Balanced "close beside". Readable says plainly where he lay at the table, as meaning decision m1 describes.

decisions.choice: [the one] whom Jesus loved (L); the disciple whom Jesus loved (B, R)
decisions.reason: Throughout John he is "the disciple whom Jesus loved", never named and never given a new title. Literal keeps the clause at the end, where the Greek has it; Balanced and Readable use the full phrase so that readers meet it here in the form it will keep.

decisions.choice: en el seno de Jesús (L); junto a él (B); justo al lado ... cerca de su pecho (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "seno", the word of 1:18, so the possible echo can be seen (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable say where he lay (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: ameegemea kifuani mwa Yesu (L); ameegemea karibu naye (B); amelala ... karibu na kifua chake (R)
decisions.reason: Guests lay on couches, leaning on the left elbow, so the disciple's head was near Jesus's chest, as the meaning note says. "Kuegemea" (to lean, recline) keeps that posture; "kuketi" (to sit) would picture chairs.

decisions.choice: nằm nghiêng nơi lòng Đức Giê-xu (L); nằm nghiêng sát bên Ngài (B); nằm ngay cạnh ... sát bên ngực Ngài (R)
decisions.reason: Guests lay on couches at the meal, so the disciple's head was near Jesus's chest, as the meaning note says. "Nằm" keeps that posture; "ngồi" (sit) would picture chairs.

decisions.choice: "기대어 누워 있었다" (lying, leaning) at every level
decisions.reason: Guests at a formal meal lay on couches around a low table (meaning decision); Korean "앉다" would picture a modern table and make the next verses, where the disciple leans back onto Jesus's chest, hard to follow.

source.text: νεύει οὖν τούτῳ Σίμων Πέτρος πυθέσθαι τίς ἂν εἴη περὶ οὗ λέγει.

records.literal_gloss: Nods therefore to this one Simon Peter to inquire who it might be about whom he speaks.

en.L: So Simon Peter nods to this one to inquire who it might be of whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} speaks.
en.B: So Simon Peter signaled to him to find out who it could be that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} meant.
en.R: So Simon Peter made a sign to that disciple. He wanted him to find out from Jesus which one {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} meant.

es.L: Le hace señas, pues, Simón Pedro a este para que pregunte quién sería aquel de quien habla.
es.B: Simón Pedro le hizo señas para que averiguara a quién se refería.
es.R: Entonces Simón Pedro le hizo una seña a ese discípulo. Quería que le preguntara a Jesús a quién se refería.

sw.L: Basi Simoni Petro anamwashiria huyu kwa kichwa, ili aulize huenda ni nani anayemzungumzia.
sw.B: Basi Simoni Petro akamwashiria ili aulize ni nani aliyemaanisha.
sw.R: Basi Simoni Petro akampa ishara yule mwanafunzi. Alitaka amwulize Yesu ni yupi aliyemaanisha.

vi.L: Vậy Si-môn Phi-e-rơ gật đầu ra hiệu cho người này để hỏi xem có thể là ai mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói đến.
vi.B: Vậy Si-môn Phi-e-rơ ra hiệu cho người ấy hỏi xem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn nói ai.
vi.R: Vậy Si-môn Phi-e-rơ ra dấu cho người môn đồ đó. Ông muốn người ấy hỏi Đức Giê-xu xem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn nói ai.

ko.L: 그래서 시몬 베드로가 이 사람에게 고갯짓을 하여, 그분이 말씀하시는 사람이 누구일지 알아보라고 한다.
ko.B: 그래서 시몬 베드로가 그에게 고갯짓으로 신호를 보내어, 예수께서 말씀하시는 사람이 누구인지 알아보게 했다.
ko.R: 그러자 시몬 베드로가 그 제자에게 고개로 신호를 보냈다. 예수께 누구를 두고 하신 말씀인지 여쭈어 보라는 뜻이었다.

decisions.choice: to inquire who it might be (SBLGNT)
alternatives: and says to him, "Tell us who it is"
decisions.reason: Some important manuscripts, among them Codex Vaticanus, have Peter speak: "and he says to him, 'Say who it is of whom he speaks.'" Others, together with the SBLGNT, have only the sign and its purpose; Codex Sinaiticus combines the two. The meaning is much the same: Peter wants the disciple next to Jesus to find out. A footnote gives the other reading. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: nods: makes a sign with the head, without speaking
decisions.reason: The verb means to nod or beckon (Acts 24:10). Peter signals rather than asking aloud. He was probably not lying next to Jesus himself, and the question could not be asked openly across the table.

decisions.choice: to inquire who it might be: to find out, by asking Jesus
decisions.reason: The mood of "might be" makes the question tentative, as a question one is not sure can be answered. The next verse shows how the disciple found out: he asked Jesus directly.

decisions.choice: nods (Literal); signaled (Balanced); made a sign (Readable); likewise in verses 25, 26 and 27
decisions.reason: John often tells a story in the present tense ("he nods", "he says", "he answers", "he gives") for vividness. Literal keeps the present; Balanced and Readable use the past, as stories are normally told in this language. This applies to every such verb in the passage (verses 24, 25, 26 and 27).

decisions.choice: that disciple ... He wanted him to find out from Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says who "this one" is and whom he was to ask, as verse 25 shows (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal; pretérito at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in John: Literal keeps John's present ("dice", "ven"); Balanced and Readable use the pretérito. This applies throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: ese discípulo ... le preguntara a Jesús
decisions.reason: As in English.

decisions.choice: historic present "한다", "말한다", "말씀하신다" (L); past (B, R), through this passage
decisions.reason: Literal keeps John's present tense in narrative (13:24, 25, 26, 27), which Korean can do for vividness; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the past. One decision for 13:21-30.

source.text: ἀναπεσὼν ἐκεῖνος οὕτως ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ· Κύριε, τίς ἐστιν;

records.literal_gloss: Having leaned back that one thus upon the chest of the Jesus says to him, "Lord, who is it?"

en.L: That one, leaning back thus on the chest of Jesus, says to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, who is it?"
en.B: Leaning back against Jesus's chest as he lay, the disciple asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, who is it?"
en.R: So that disciple leaned back against Jesus's chest and asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, who is it?"

es.L: Aquel, recostándose así sobre el pecho de Jesús, le dice: «Señor, ¿quién es?».
es.B: El discípulo, inclinándose hacia atrás sobre el pecho de Jesús, le preguntó: «Señor, ¿quién es?».
es.R: Así que ese discípulo se inclinó hacia atrás, sobre el pecho de Jesús, y le preguntó: «Señor, ¿quién es?».

sw.L: Yule, akiegemea hivyo kifuani pa Yesu, anamwambia, "Bwana, ni nani?"
sw.B: Yule mwanafunzi, akiwa ameegemea kifuani pa Yesu alipokuwa amelala, akamwuliza, "Bwana, ni nani?"
sw.R: Basi yule mwanafunzi akaegemea kifua cha Yesu, akamwuliza, "Bwana, ni nani?"

vi.L: Người ấy, cứ thế ngả người ra trên ngực Đức Giê-xu, nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Chúa, là ai vậy?"
vi.B: Người môn đồ ấy, đang nằm, ngả đầu vào ngực Đức Giê-xu và hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Chúa, người đó là ai?"
vi.R: Vậy người môn đồ ấy ngả vào ngực Đức Giê-xu và hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Chúa, đó là ai vậy?"

ko.L: 그 사람이 그렇게 예수의 가슴에 기대어 그분께 말한다. "주님, 누구입니까?"
ko.B: 그 제자는 누운 채로 예수의 가슴 쪽으로 몸을 젖혀 기대고 여쭈었다. "주님, 그게 누구입니까?"
ko.R: 그래서 그 제자가 예수의 가슴에 몸을 기대고 여쭈었다. "주님, 그게 누구입니까?"

decisions.choice: leaning back thus: tipping his head back against Jesus's chest, from where he lay
decisions.reason: The verb means to lean or fall back. "Thus" means just as he was, without changing his place at the table (verse 23). Lying beside Jesus, he had only to lean back for his head to rest against Jesus's chest, where he could ask quietly. "Chest" is a different word from "bosom" in verse 23; it names the body itself.

decisions.choice: leaning back thus (SBLGNT)
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts have a verb meaning "falling on" in place of "leaning back", and some important manuscripts leave out "thus". Neither change alters the scene. No footnote is needed. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Lord: the address of a disciple to his teacher and master
decisions.reason: The disciples call Jesus "Lord" (6:68; 11:12; 13:6, 9), and he has just accepted the title (13:13).

decisions.choice: as he lay ... the disciple asked (B); So that disciple leaned back ... and asked (R)
alternatives: That one, leaning back thus, says (Literal)
decisions.reason: Balanced gives "thus" as "as he lay" (meaning decision m1); both say who "that one" is. Both use the past tense (see verse 24, rendering decision r-en-1).

decisions.choice: Señor
decisions.reason: A disciple's address to his master (meaning decision m3); "Señor" at every level, as elsewhere in John.

decisions.choice: Thưa Chúa
decisions.reason: A disciple addresses Jesus with kyrie, so "Chúa" as the style guide sets for disciples; "thưa" is the respectful particle Vietnamese needs and is not bracketed. "Lạy" belongs to prayer.

decisions.choice: "주님" with 합쇼체 ("누구입니까?"); "여쭈었다" (B, R) for "said"
decisions.reason: A disciple addresses his master as "주님" (style guide, section 6) and speaks to him in 합쇼체 (section 4). Balanced and Readable use the humble verb "여쭈다" for asking a superior; Literal keeps the plain "말한다" of the Greek.

source.text: ἀποκρίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ᾧ ἐγὼ βάψω τὸ ψωμίον καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ· βάψας οὖν τὸ ψωμίον δίδωσιν Ἰούδᾳ Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου.

records.literal_gloss: Answers the Jesus, "That one it is for whom I will dip the morsel and will give to him." Having dipped therefore the morsel he gives [it] to Judas of Simon Iscariot.

en.L: Jesus answers, "It is that one for whom I will dip the morsel and give [it] to him." So having dipped the morsel, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives [it] to Judas [son] of Simon Iscariot.
en.B: Jesus answered, "I will dip this piece of bread and give it to someone; he is the one." So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dipped the bread and gave it to Judas, son of Simon Iscariot.
en.R: Jesus answered, "I am going to dip this piece of bread and give it to one of you. He is the one." Then Jesus dipped the bread and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

es.L: Responde Jesús: «Es aquel a quien yo daré el bocado que voy a mojar». Y mojando el bocado, lo da a Judas, [hijo] de Simón Iscariote.
es.B: Jesús respondió: «Voy a mojar este pedazo de pan y se lo daré a uno; ese es». Y mojó el pan y se lo dio a Judas, hijo de Simón Iscariote.
es.R: Jesús respondió: «Voy a mojar este pedazo de pan y se lo voy a dar a uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ese es». Entonces Jesús mojó el pan y se lo dio a Judas, el hijo de Simón Iscariote.

sw.L: Yesu anajibu, "Ni yule ambaye nitachovya kipande na kumpa." Basi, akiisha kuchovya kipande, anampa Yuda [mwana] wa Simoni Iskariote.
sw.B: Yesu akajibu, "Nitachovya kipande hiki cha mkate na kumpa mtu; huyo ndiye." Basi akachovya mkate, akampa Yuda, mwana wa Simoni Iskariote.
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Nitachovya kipande hiki cha mkate na kumpa mmoja wenu. Huyo ndiye." Kisha Yesu akachovya mkate, akampa Yuda, mwana wa Simoni Iskariote.

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Đó là người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chấm miếng bánh và trao cho người ấy." Vậy, chấm miếng bánh xong, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trao cho Giu-đa [con] của Si-môn Ích-ca-ri-ốt.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Ta sẽ chấm miếng bánh này rồi trao cho một người; chính là người đó." Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chấm bánh và trao cho Giu-đa, con của Si-môn Ích-ca-ri-ốt.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta sẽ chấm miếng bánh này rồi đưa cho một người trong các con. Chính người đó." Rồi Đức Giê-xu chấm bánh và đưa cho Giu-đa, con của Si-môn Ích-ca-ri-ốt.

ko.L: 예수께서 대답하신다. "내가 [빵] 조각을 적셔서 그에게 줄 사람, 그가 바로 그 사람이다." 그래서 그 조각을 적셔서 가룟 시몬의 [아들] 유다에게 주신다.
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 이 빵 조각을 적셔서 주는 사람이 바로 그 사람이다." 그리고 빵 조각을 적셔서 가룟 시몬의 아들 유다에게 주셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 이 빵 한 조각을 그릇에 찍어서 줄 것이다. 그것을 받는 사람이 바로 그 사람이다." 그리고 예수께서는 빵을 찍어서 가룟 시몬의 아들 유다에게 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the morsel: a small piece of bread, dipped into the common dish
alternatives: the bread of the Lord's Supper
decisions.reason: The word means a small bite or piece, normally of bread. At the meal the diners dipped bread into a shared bowl of sauce (Mark 14:20). John does not tell of Jesus giving thanks over the bread and the cup at this meal, and nothing here suggests that this piece of bread is part of such a rite.

decisions.choice: giving a dipped morsel: a gesture of friendship toward a guest
alternatives: only a sign to point out the betrayer
decisions.reason: A host might honor a guest by dipping a piece of bread and handing it to him. If that is so here, Jesus's last act toward Judas is one of friendship, which makes the betrayal darker and fulfills the scripture just quoted: the one who eats Jesus's bread has lifted his heel against him (13:18; Psalm 41:10). How widely the custom was practiced is not certain; the gesture is at least a sign of shared table fellowship.

decisions.choice: he gives (SBLGNT)
decisions.reason: Some important manuscripts, among them Codex Vaticanus, read "he takes and gives", in words that recall the accounts of the Lord's Supper. Others, among them an early papyrus and Codex Sinaiticus, have only "he gives", as the SBLGNT does. The sense is the same. A footnote gives the longer reading. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Iscariot, describing Simon: Judas son of Simon Iscariot (SBLGNT)
alternatives: Judas son of Simon, from Kerioth
decisions.reason: As in 6:71, the name Iscariot agrees in form with Simon, so it belongs to the father as well as the son. Many later manuscripts make it agree with Judas, and a few have "from Kerioth". A footnote gives the other readings. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: this piece of bread, the bread (B, R); I will dip ... he is the one (B, R)
alternatives: It is the one to whom I give (Literal order)
decisions.reason: "Piece of bread" says in common words what the morsel was (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps "morsel". Balanced and Readable tell the action first and then say "he is the one", which is the natural order for this answer in this language.

decisions.choice: [son] of Simon (L); son of Simon (B); the son of Simon (R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:71, the Greek gives the father's name without a noun, and "son" is understood.

decisions.choice: el bocado (L); este pedazo de pan, el pan (B, R)
decisions.reason: A small piece of bread dipped in the common dish (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: [hijo] de Simón (L); hijo de Simón (B, R)
decisions.reason: As at 6:71.

decisions.choice: kipande (L); kipande cha mkate, mkate (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning note: a small piece of bread, dipped in the dish. Literal says "kipande" (piece), as the English says "morsel"; Balanced and Readable name the bread. "Tonge" is a lump of food rolled in the fingers, a different picture. The same in verses 27 and 30.

decisions.choice: "가룟 시몬의 [아들] 유다" (L); "가룟 시몬의 아들 유다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: In the SBLGNT "Iscariot" describes Simon (meaning decision), so Korean puts "가룟" before "시몬". The familiar "가룟 유다" would follow the other reading.

source.text: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ψωμίον τότε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ἐκεῖνον ὁ Σατανᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: And after the morsel then entered into that one the Satan.

en.L: And after the morsel, then Satan entered into that one.
en.B: Once Judas had received the bread, Satan entered into him.
en.R: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan went into him.

es.L: Y después del bocado, entonces entró en aquel Satanás.
es.B: En cuanto Judas recibió el pan, Satanás entró en él.
es.R: Tan pronto como Judas tomó el pan, Satanás entró en él.

sw.L: Na baada ya kile kipande, ndipo Shetani akamwingia yule.
sw.B: Mara Yuda alipokipokea kipande cha mkate, Shetani akamwingia.
sw.R: Mara tu Yuda alipochukua mkate, Shetani akamwingia.

vi.L: Và sau miếng bánh, lúc ấy Sa-tan nhập vào người ấy.
vi.B: Giu-đa vừa nhận miếng bánh thì Sa-tan nhập vào người ấy.
vi.R: Giu-đa vừa cầm lấy bánh thì Sa-tan nhập vào người ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그 조각 [뒤에], 그때 사탄이 그 사람 안으로 들어갔다.
ko.B: 유다가 빵 조각을 받자 바로 그때 사탄이 그에게 들어갔다.
ko.R: 유다가 빵을 받자마자 사탄이 그 안에 들어갔다.

decisions.choice: Satan: the enemy of God, the same figure as the devil in 13:2
alternatives: a figure of speech for Judas's own evil
decisions.reason: This is the only time John uses the name Satan, which means "adversary". In 13:2 the devil had already put the plan to betray Jesus into Judas's heart; now he takes hold of Judas himself. Luke says the same in almost the same words (Luke 22:3). John holds both together: Satan is at work, and Judas is responsible for what he does (6:70-71; 12:6).

decisions.choice: after the morsel, then: at that very point, not because of the bread
alternatives: the bread was the means by which Satan entered
decisions.reason: "Then" stresses the moment: once Judas had taken the bread Jesus offered, Satan entered him. The gift of friendship (verse 26) is followed by the decisive turn. John does not say that the bread caused it.

decisions.choice: entered into him: took control of him
decisions.reason: To "enter into" a person is said of evil spirits taking possession (Mark 5:12-13; Luke 8:30). Here it means that Judas now gave himself over completely to Satan's purpose.

decisions.choice: Once Judas had received the bread (B); As soon as Judas took the bread (R); him
alternatives: After the bread, then Satan entered into that one (Literal)
decisions.reason: "After the morsel" means after Judas had received it (verse 30). Balanced and Readable say so, and name Judas, since "that one" could be unclear. "Once" and "as soon as" give the force of "then" (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: Judas; el pan
decisions.reason: As in English (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: Sa-tan; người ấy (for Judas)
decisions.reason: "Sa-tan" is the established Protestant spelling. Judas is "người ấy", a neutral pronoun; "hắn" would add the narrator's contempt, which the Greek "that one" does not express.

source.text: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὃ ποιεῖς ποίησον τάχιον.

records.literal_gloss: Says therefore to him the Jesus, "What you are doing, do more quickly."

en.L: So Jesus says to him, "What you are doing, do more quickly."
en.B: So Jesus told him, "Do quickly what you are doing."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Do what you are going to do, and do it fast."

es.L: Le dice, pues, Jesús: «Lo que haces, hazlo más pronto».
es.B: Entonces Jesús le dijo: «Lo que vas a hacer, hazlo pronto».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Lo que vas a hacer, hazlo ya».

sw.L: Basi Yesu anamwambia, "Unalofanya, lifanye upesi zaidi."
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia, "Fanya unachokusudia kufanya, na ukifanye haraka."

vi.L: Vậy Đức Giê-xu phán với người ấy: "Việc con đang làm, hãy làm mau hơn."
vi.B: Vậy Đức Giê-xu bảo người ấy: "Việc con đang làm, hãy làm nhanh đi."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với Giu-đa: "Điều con định làm, hãy làm nhanh đi."

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그에게 말씀하신다. "네가 하는 것을 더 빨리 하여라."
ko.B: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 하는 일을 어서 하여라."
ko.R: 예수께서 유다에게 말씀하셨다. "네가 하려는 일을 빨리 해라."

decisions.choice: what you are doing: what Judas has already set in motion
alternatives: what you are in the habit of doing
decisions.reason: The present tense speaks of the plan as already under way. Judas had made up his mind (13:2), and Jesus shows that he knows.

decisions.choice: more quickly: quickly, at once
decisions.reason: The word is a comparative, "more quickly", but such forms are often used with the plain sense "quickly" or "without delay". Where John uses it of the race to the tomb (20:4), a real comparison is meant; here no one else is in view.

decisions.choice: Jesus remains in command of the events leading to his death
alternatives: Jesus approves of what Judas is doing
decisions.reason: Jesus does not approve the betrayal; he has just called it a fulfillment of scripture done by one who shares his bread (13:18). His words show that his death is not forced on him: he lays down his life of his own accord (10:18), and the hour has come (13:1).

decisions.choice: what you are going to do
decisions.reason: The plan was under way but the deed itself had not yet been done (meaning decision m1). Readable says plainly that it was about to happen.

decisions.choice: Lo que vas a hacer
decisions.reason: What Judas has already set in motion (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: con (Jesus to Judas)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Judas as to any of his disciples ("con"); "ngươi" would make him harsh, which the Greek does not.

source.text: τοῦτο δὲ οὐδεὶς ἔγνω τῶν ἀνακειμένων πρὸς τί εἶπεν αὐτῷ·

records.literal_gloss: This but no one knew of the [ones] reclining for what he said to him;

en.L: But no one of those reclining [at the table] knew for what [reason] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said this to him.
en.B: But none of those at the table understood what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} meant by saying this to him.
en.R: But nobody at the table understood why Jesus said this to Judas.

es.L: Pero ninguno de los que estaban recostados [a la mesa] entendió para qué le dijo esto.
es.B: Pero ninguno de los que estaban a la mesa entendió por qué le dijo eso.
es.R: Pero ninguno de los que estaban a la mesa entendió por qué Jesús le dijo eso a Judas.

sw.L: Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wa wale walioketi [mezani] aliyejua ni kwa sababu gani alimwambia hivi.
sw.B: Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wa wale waliokuwa mezani aliyeelewa alimaanisha nini kwa kumwambia hivyo.
sw.R: Lakini hakuna mtu mezani aliyeelewa kwa nini Yesu alimwambia Yuda hivyo.

vi.L: Nhưng không ai trong những người đang nằm [quanh bàn] biết vì [lý do] gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói điều này với người ấy.
vi.B: Nhưng không ai trong số những người cùng bàn hiểu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói vậy với người ấy là có ý gì.
vi.R: Nhưng không ai ngồi trong bàn ăn hiểu tại sao Đức Giê-xu nói như vậy với Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그러나 [식탁에] 기대어 누운 사람들 가운데 아무도 무엇 때문에 그분이 그에게 이것을 말씀하셨는지 알지 못했다.
ko.B: 그러나 함께 식사하던 사람들 가운데 아무도 예수께서 무슨 뜻으로 그에게 이 말씀을 하셨는지 알지 못했다.
ko.R: 그러나 식탁에 있던 사람들은 아무도 예수께서 왜 유다에게 이런 말씀을 하셨는지 몰랐다.

decisions.choice: those reclining: the people at the meal
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 23 describes the guests lying at the table (meaning decision m1 there).

decisions.choice: no one: the others did not understand the purpose of Jesus's words
alternatives: the disciple whom Jesus loved did not know who the betrayer was
decisions.reason: Jesus had answered the disciple whom Jesus loved by pointing to the one who would receive the bread (verse 26). John does not say whether that disciple saw what it meant at once, or passed it on to Peter. What none of them understood was why Jesus sent Judas away; the next verse gives their guesses.

decisions.choice: knew for what: understood for what purpose
decisions.reason: They had heard the words; they did not know their purpose. The phrase asks what the words were for.

decisions.choice: Jesus ... Judas
decisions.reason: Readable names both people, since "he" and "him" could be confused.

decisions.choice: Jesús ... Judas
decisions.reason: As in English.

source.text: τινὲς γὰρ ἐδόκουν, ἐπεὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον εἶχεν Ἰούδας, ὅτι λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀγόρασον ὧν χρείαν ἔχομεν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἢ τοῖς πτωχοῖς ἵνα τι δῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Some for were thinking, since the money box had Judas, that says to him the Jesus, "Buy [the things] of which need we have for the feast," or to the poor that something he should give.

en.L: For some were thinking, since Judas had the money box, that Jesus was saying to him, "Buy what we have need of for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.
en.B: Since Judas kept the money box, some thought Jesus was telling him, "Buy what we need for the festival," or that he was to give something to the poor.
en.R: Judas was in charge of the group's money box. So some of them thought Jesus was telling him to buy what they needed for the festival. Others thought Jesus wanted him to give some money to poor people.

es.L: Porque algunos pensaban, puesto que Judas tenía la bolsa, que Jesús le decía: «Compra lo que necesitamos para la fiesta», o que diera algo a los pobres.
es.B: Como Judas tenía la bolsa del dinero, algunos pensaban que Jesús le estaba diciendo: «Compra lo que necesitamos para la fiesta», o que diera algo a los pobres.
es.R: Judas estaba a cargo de la bolsa del dinero del grupo. Por eso algunos pensaron que Jesús le estaba diciendo que comprara lo que necesitaban para la fiesta. Otros pensaron que Jesús quería que les diera algo de dinero a los pobres.

sw.L: Kwa maana wengine walidhani, kwa kuwa Yuda alikuwa na mfuko wa fedha, kwamba Yesu alikuwa akimwambia, "Nunua tunavyohitaji kwa ajili ya sikukuu," au kwamba atoe kitu kwa maskini.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa Yuda alishika mfuko wa fedha, wengine walidhani Yesu alikuwa akimwambia, "Nunua tunachohitaji kwa sikukuu," au kwamba atoe kitu kwa maskini.
sw.R: Yuda ndiye aliyeshika mfuko wa fedha wa kikundi. Kwa hiyo baadhi yao walidhani Yesu alikuwa akimwambia anunue walichohitaji kwa sikukuu. Wengine walidhani Yesu alitaka awape watu maskini fedha kidogo.

vi.L: Vì có mấy người nghĩ rằng, bởi Giu-đa giữ túi tiền, nên Đức Giê-xu bảo người ấy: "Hãy mua những gì chúng ta cần cho kỳ lễ," hoặc bảo người ấy cho người nghèo vật gì.
vi.B: Vì Giu-đa giữ túi tiền, nên có người nghĩ Đức Giê-xu bảo người ấy: "Hãy mua những thứ chúng ta cần cho kỳ lễ," hoặc bảo người ấy đem cho người nghèo chút gì.
vi.R: Giu-đa là người giữ túi tiền chung của cả nhóm. Nên có mấy người nghĩ Đức Giê-xu bảo người ấy đi mua những thứ cả nhóm cần cho kỳ lễ. Có người lại nghĩ Đức Giê-xu muốn người ấy đem ít tiền cho người nghèo.

ko.L: 어떤 이들은, 유다가 돈궤를 가지고 있었으므로, 예수께서 그에게 "우리가 명절에 쓸 것을 사라" 하신다고, 또는 가난한 사람들에게 무엇을 주라고 하신다고 생각하고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 유다가 돈궤를 맡고 있었기 때문에, 어떤 이들은 예수께서 그에게 "명절에 우리가 쓸 것을 사 오너라" 하셨거나, 가난한 사람들에게 무엇을 주라고 하셨다고 생각했다.
ko.R: 유다는 제자들의 돈 상자를 맡고 있었다. 그래서 어떤 제자들은 예수께서 유다에게 명절에 필요한 것을 사 오라고 하셨다고 생각했다. 또 다른 제자들은 가난한 사람들에게 돈을 좀 주라고 하셨다고 생각했다.

decisions.choice: had the money box: kept the group's common money
alternatives: owned a box of his own
decisions.reason: As in 12:6, the money box is the box in which Jesus and his disciples kept their money, and Judas was in charge of it. That is why the others thought Jesus was sending him on an errand.

decisions.choice: the feast: the Passover festival, which was about to begin
decisions.reason: John set this meal "before the feast of the Passover" (13:1). The festival, with the Feast of Unleavened Bread joined to it, lasted seven days, and food and other things had to be bought for it. The disciples' guess fits a time when the feast was still ahead; compare 18:28, where the next morning the authorities had not yet eaten the Passover.

decisions.choice: give something to the poor: giving alms, a recognized duty
decisions.reason: Giving to the poor was a religious duty in Israel (Deuteronomy 15:11), and Passover was a time when the poor were remembered. The group seems to have done so from its common money (12:5-6).

decisions.choice: Jesus says to him: the words as the disciples imagined them
decisions.reason: The present tense gives what they supposed Jesus was saying, in the form they imagined it; then the sentence changes to reported speech for the second guess ("that he should give").

decisions.choice: money box (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same words as in 12:6, so that readers can see that it is the same box and the same Judas.

decisions.choice: the group's money box; Others thought; some money
decisions.reason: Readable splits the two guesses into separate sentences and says what Judas would have given. As in 12:6, it adds whose money box it was.

decisions.choice: la bolsa (L); la bolsa del dinero (B, R)
decisions.reason: As at 12:6.

decisions.choice: mfuko wa fedha
decisions.reason: The same word as at 12:6, so the same rendering: the common purse Judas kept for the group.

decisions.choice: chúng ta
decisions.reason: In the words the disciples imagine, Jesus includes himself with them, so the inclusive "chúng ta".

decisions.choice: "돈궤" (L, B), "돈 상자" (R); "명절" for the feast
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a box, not a bag; "돈궤" is the ordinary word, and Readable says "돈 상자" for younger readers. "명절" is the everyday word for a religious festival; "축제" would sound secular.

source.text: λαβὼν οὖν τὸ ψωμίον ἐκεῖνος ἐξῆλθεν εὐθύς.

records.literal_gloss: Having received therefore the morsel that one went out immediately.

en.L: So having received the morsel, that one went out immediately.
en.B: So once he had taken the piece of bread, Judas went straight out.
en.R: Judas took the bread and left right away.

es.L: Así que, habiendo tomado el bocado, aquel salió enseguida.
es.B: Así que, en cuanto tomó el pedazo de pan, Judas salió inmediatamente.
es.R: Judas tomó el pan y se fue enseguida.

sw.L: Basi akiisha kukipokea kile kipande, yule akatoka mara moja.
sw.B: Basi Yuda alipokwisha kuchukua kipande cha mkate, akatoka mara moja.
sw.R: Yuda akachukua mkate, akaondoka mara moja.

vi.L: Vậy nhận miếng bánh xong, người ấy liền đi ra.
vi.B: Vậy khi đã nhận miếng bánh, Giu-đa liền đi ra ngoài.
vi.R: Giu-đa cầm lấy bánh rồi đi ra ngay.

ko.L: 그래서 그 사람은 그 조각을 받고 곧바로 나갔다.
ko.B: 유다는 빵 조각을 받고 곧바로 밖으로 나갔다.
ko.R: 유다는 빵을 받고 바로 나가 버렸다.

decisions.choice: having received ... went out immediately: Judas leaves as soon as he has the bread
alternatives: he ate it and then left
decisions.reason: The participle and "immediately" tie his leaving closely to receiving the bread and to Jesus's words, "Do quickly what you are doing" (verse 27).

decisions.choice: went out: left the room and the company of Jesus and the disciples
decisions.reason: He leaves the meal to carry out the betrayal. He will next appear in the garden, leading the soldiers and the officers (18:2-3).

decisions.choice: Judas (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Judas for "that one", so the reader does not take it to be the disciple last mentioned in verse 25.

decisions.choice: Judas
decisions.reason: As in English.

vi.L: Và lúc ấy là ban đêm.
vi.R: Lúc đó đã là ban đêm.

decisions.choice: night: the time of day; the meal was held after dark
decisions.reason: The Passover meal was eaten at night (Exodus 12:8), and this meal, held at the same season, was also at night. Judas goes out into the dark.

decisions.choice: night: also the darkness that Jesus, the light, had spoken of
alternatives: only a note of the time
decisions.reason: John often sets light against darkness (1:5; 3:19; 8:12). Jesus had said that night comes when no one can work (9:4), that whoever walks in the night stumbles (11:10), and that those who walk in darkness do not know where they are going (12:35). The short sentence, placed where it is, seems to carry that weight as Judas leaves the light. John does not spell it out, and the plain sense stands first.

decisions.choice: And it was night (L, B); It was night (R)
decisions.reason: The sentence is three words in Greek, and its force lies in its shortness (meaning decision m2). Every level keeps it short and adds nothing; Readable drops only "And".

decisions.choice: Y era de noche (L, B); Era de noche (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the short sentence, which also says something about the darkness (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: ban đêm
decisions.reason: "Đêm" keeps the noun "night", which also carries the darkness Jesus spoke of; "trời đã tối" would say only that it was dark.
